_readme: Company -> platform/token config for the automated job monitor. Generic platforms (greenhouse/ashby/lever) use a shared fetch+filter routine keyed on 'token'. 'special' platform means the company has a bespoke handler function in monitor.py (see PLATFORM_NOTES in that file). 'unresolved' means no working token/platform could be re-derived via automated slug-guessing as of 2026-07-12 and needs a fresh manual check (a link from Dimitry, or dedicated investigation) before it can be monitored automatically. 'location_flexible': N surfaces a company's postings regardless of location (bypassing the NY/US-remote gate). NY and US-remote postings are treated as the ideal; a genuinely out-of-area posting scores N points below that ideal (so N=0.5 puts an SF role half a point under a NY/remote role of the same fit).
